name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: A box to turn one option on or off, or a group of boxes for several options.

when: Agreeing to something, or choosing several options from a few.

guidance.rule: Write the option positively: "Send notifications", not "Don't send…".

builtIn: Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.
youProvide: A label for each box and a legend for the group.

genui.description: A checkbox; children is the option text, written positively. Emits change.
